gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-balines: Noto Sans Balinese reads with a breathing space inside every curved glyph, modern and unfussy. Nulshock does best at stretched, technical boldness, while the sans-serif body does best at staying out of its way.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Noto Sans Bamum reads clean and modern, its curved strokes stopping short before they turn inward. And Nulshock is best when its lines bend like tubing, while the sans text is best at small letters with big counters.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-bassa-v: Nulshock gives its curves the same heft as its straight stems, all stretched and widely spaced. Noto Sans Bassa Vah takes the quiet job, its dominant midsection filling the line, while Nulshock handles the announcing.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-batak: Nulshock draws every glyph with a single-width stroke, stretched and widely spaced. Shrink Nulshock and its generous tracking starts to scatter, while a large Noto Sans Batak only exaggerates its already towering x-height.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Technical from the first glance, Nulshock draws a single unmodulated outline. What stands out is how Noto Sans Bengali stays a plain sans with open mouths while Nulshock stretches out loud.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksu: Nulshock stretches its bold, technical letters wide, with spacious tracking and a bent-pipe outline that never changes width. Nulshock is best at impact, Noto Sans Bhaiksuki at easy sans-serif reading.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Nulshock keeps its terminals the width they began, stretched wide and technical, made to be seen first. Noto Sans Brahmi, a sans with a high mean line and open-ended curves, is built to be read afterward.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-bugines: Technical to the bone, Nulshock stretches wide with no calligraphic swell on any downstroke. But Noto Sans Buginese does the modern sans reading with chalk-arc open mouths, leaving the bold stretching to Nulshock.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Nulshock gives every curve the weight of a stem, like cord, stretched wide. Noto Sans Buhid adds a high x-height and generous gaps at its curve ends, so the sans text breathes under all that cord.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-carian: Nulshock draws like a fineliner on paper, flat and bold, stretched with spacious tracking. Noto Sans Carian, a sans with terminals held apart like scissor blades, can go a size up without losing its clean look.
